Course curriculum

A structured path from fundamentals to execution.

The curriculum below is a proposed course outline. Confirm the final module list and schedule with Edurup Learning before publishing it as a formal syllabus.

01Digital marketing foundationsUnderstand how digital channels support business goals and customer journeys.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Digital marketing ecosystem and channel overview
  • Customer personas and audience research
  • Marketing funnels and customer journey mapping
  • Campaign objectives, KPIs and SMART goals
  • Competitor research and positioning basics
02SEO and content marketingLearn how websites and content can improve organic search visibility.＋

Subtopics covered

  • How search engines crawl, index and rank pages
  • Keyword research and search intent
  • On-page SEO: titles, headings, URLs and internal links
  • Technical SEO basics: indexing, sitemaps and robots.txt
  • Content briefs, topic clusters and content calendars
  • SEO audits and performance measurement
03Social media marketingPlan useful content and build a consistent social media presence.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Platform selection and audience fit
  • Content pillars and monthly content calendars
  • Creative formats: reels, stories, carousels and posts
  • Copywriting, hooks and calls to action
  • Community management and engagement
  • Social media metrics and reporting
04Google Ads and paid searchExplore the core workflow for setting up and improving search campaigns.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Google Ads account and campaign structure
  • Keyword match types and search terms
  • Writing responsive search ad copy
  • Budgeting, bidding and campaign settings
  • Landing page relevance and conversion goals
  • Search terms review and optimisation basics
05Meta Ads and performance marketingUnderstand paid social campaigns, creative testing and measurement.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Meta campaign objectives and account structure
  • Audience targeting and retargeting concepts
  • Ad creative, copy and offer alignment
  • Pixel and conversion tracking concepts
  • A/B testing and creative iteration
  • Reading CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL and ROAS
06Analytics and reportingMeasure activity and communicate campaign performance clearly.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Google Analytics 4 navigation and key reports
  • Events, conversions and traffic acquisition
  • UTM parameters and campaign tagging
  • Google Tag Manager fundamentals
  • Dashboard design and reporting narratives
  • Turning insights into optimisation actions
07AI tools and marketing workflowsUse AI responsibly to support research, ideation and analysis.＋

Subtopics covered

  • Prompting for campaign ideas and audience insights
  • AI-assisted content outlines and first drafts
  • Creative variations and ad copy testing ideas
  • Research synthesis and competitor summaries
  • Marketing workflow automation concepts
  • Fact-checking, brand voice, privacy and human review
08Portfolio and career readinessBring learning together in a structured portfolio and interview narrative.＋

Subtopics covered

  • SEO audit and keyword mapping project
  • Social media calendar and creative brief
  • Paid campaign plan and sample ad creatives
  • Analytics dashboard and campaign report
  • Portfolio case study: goal, approach and learnings
  • CV, portfolio walkthrough and interview practice
Project-based learning

Turn concepts into work you can show.

Build examples that demonstrate how you plan, execute and evaluate marketing activity.

  • SEO audit and keyword map for a sample website
  • Social media content calendar and creative brief
  • Google or Meta Ads campaign plan
  • UTM tracking and campaign performance report
Practice → Build → Improve

Build a portfolio with a clear story.

Explain the goal, your approach, the tools used and what you would improve next. Project examples should be labelled as practice work unless they were completed for a real client.

About the Edurup Learning Digital Marketing Course Certificate

The course is designed to help you practise the core activities involved in digital marketing, from planning campaigns and creating content to measuring results. Your certificate can document course completion and the learning covered, according to Edurup Learning’s final assessment and issuing policy.

Looking for digital marketing training in Bangalore? Edurup Learning welcomes enquiries from learners in Bengaluru, including Marathahalli and Whitefield. Contact our team to confirm the current training address, batch timings and whether the upcoming course is classroom-based, online or hybrid.

Learning topics include digital marketing fundamentals, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content planning, analytics and AI-assisted workflows. Practical exercises and portfolio-style projects help you explain your approach and demonstrate what you have learned.

Use your project work to talk through the brief, your decisions, the tools you used and what you would improve next. Employers may consider many factors beyond a course certificate, so avoid treating certification as a job guarantee.

Digital Marketing Course in Bangalore: FAQs

Where can I learn digital marketing in Bangalore?

Edurup Learning offers a digital marketing course page for learners in Bangalore (Bengaluru). Contact the team to confirm the current campus address, batch schedule and whether the next batch is classroom-based, online or hybrid.

Is the digital marketing course convenient for Marathahalli-area learners?

Edurup Learning can confirm the current training address, class format and timings so learners from Marathahalli, Brookefield and nearby areas can assess travel and schedule fit. Confirm the exact location with the team before visiting.

What topics are covered in the digital marketing course?

The proposed curriculum covers digital marketing foundations, SEO, content marketing, social media, Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics and reporting, AI-assisted workflows, portfolio projects and career preparation. Confirm the final syllabus with Edurup Learning before enrolling.

What is the course fee and payment plan?

Will I work on practical projects?

The proposed learning plan includes practice briefs and portfolio-style projects, such as an SEO audit, social media content calendar, paid campaign plan and analytics report. Confirm the final project list and delivery method with the team.

Does the course guarantee a job?

No job guarantee is stated on this page. Any career guidance or placement support should be confirmed directly with Edurup Learning and documented accurately before enrollment.
